cues.caption: Your engine is collateral. Every race buys another day. Marrow keeps the books.
Beat the division boss. Give them a reason to stand beside you.
A beaten rival. A new ally. Their backing keeps you on the road.
cues.storyBeat: boss turns ally; payout type undecided

cues.caption: Marrow has taken your car. The debt was never meant to end.
No laps. No points. The last car running ends this.
The ledger is closed. This road belongs to the living.
You made it. Good. Let me check that engine before Marrow sends you out again.
Easy. I can hold this together. Just bring it back in one piece, all right?
I checked the receipts. You keep winning, but his numbers never let you go.
cues.storyBeat: debt twist; no unsupported money destination

cues.caption: That boss is backing you now. Money, a car, parts. We finally have some help.
cues.storyBeat: ally reward types; no choice mechanic assumed

cues.caption: He took your car? Right. Right... I thought he might. Come round the back.
It is basic. I know. But I fitted a mine dispatcher. Keep moving and let him follow.
cues.storyBeat: secret basic car and mine rig

cues.caption: No finish line this time. You come back. Marrow does not.
You are back. I kept listening for the engine. Thought I had lost you.
cues.storyBeat: aftermath without promising seized car return
